name: Church of the Incarnation
description: Church of the Incarnation has been a worshipping community in Dallas since 1886. Worshipping in the Great Tradition of the Church, we invite you to join us on Sundays at 9 a.m. and 11:15 a.m. for our contemporary or traditional service or for Evensong at 5 p.m.

messaging.evidence: "grow in Christ together, to serve those in need, and to raise up godly leaders in the context of a rooted, vibrant, faith-filled community" emphasizes shared spiritual journey and community connection, while also mentioning worship tradition and service aspects
